text:
mira: Quick heads up - planning a coordinated cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. Order: runtime -> router -> api -> console. Need deploybot wave and an API schema soft-pin.
kevin: ETA per step? any long warmups?
jordan: Suggested: runtime canary 10m @ 5%, router header warmup 3m, api canary 10m, console toggle off heavy UI features during canary then full flip.
mira: We must prevent automatic API rollouts during window. Requesting a soft pin to api:payments=v2-canary; fallback api:v2-compat if mismatch.
deploybot: @mira Scheduled: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Wave created: runtime->router->api->console. Canary policy and pins attached. :robot_face:
samir: Note: new runtime does aggressive KV eviction. Insert explicit cache-evict step after runtime canary and before router header swap to avoid transient 500s. I'll run the eviction job.
ops-bot: Maintenance window reminder 02:00-03:00 UTC. Quiesce routes 30s before header flip.
kevin: Rollback checklist: 1) revert router header policy 2) pin API back to api:v1-stable 3) rollback runtime image to runtime:stable-20260328. Manual trigger; ops to run.
mira: Release notes (short): https://intranet.redwood/release/1758887777 - includes rollback commands and runbook snippets.
jordan: Add health probe requirement: GET /healthz?full=true, failfast=3. If failing, abort wave and invoke rollback.
samir: I'll own rollbacks and be on-call in this thread during the window.
deploybot: Preflight checks: infra quotas ok, canary pool healthy, pinned variants available, playbooks attached.
kevin: Please disable console telemetry and heavy widgets during canary via feature flag. Re-enable post-rollout.
mira: Console feature-flag will be toggled off at step 4 and reverted after full rollout.
jordan: Runbook excerpt added to the deploybot notes:
```
# rollback runtime image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:stable-20260328 --record
# pin api back
redwood pin api --service=payments --version=api:v1-stable --reason="rollback"
# router header revert
redwood router set-header-policy --policy=legacy
# manual cache warmup
redwood cache warmup --service=payments --scope=kv
```
mira: Any objections?
kevin: No objections, +1.
samir: +1. I'll be present at start.
mira: Ok proceeding. Ping here when starting waves; deploybot will post markers.
ops-bot: Deploybot will announce wave start and each step. Keep this channel open.
